arxiv-2109-07505.title: Light Cone Distribution Amplitudes of Heavy-Light Mesons and Quarkonia
arxiv-2109-07505.creator: Bruno El-Bennich
arxiv-2109-07505.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Bruno El-Bennich. In this work we use the framework of the Dyson-Schwinger and Bethe-Salpeter equations to compute Light-Cone Distribution Amplitudes of heavy-light mesons and quarkonia. In studying the meson properties, we introduce a flavor dependence in the heavy-quark sector of the Bethe-Salpeter ladder kernel which yields improved numerical results for masses and leptonic decay constants of the pseudoscalar D D , D s D_{s} , B B and B s B_{s} mesons.

arxiv-2112-01420.title: Transforming space with non-Hermitian dielectrics
arxiv-2112-01420.creator: Ivor Krešić, Konstantinos G. Makris, Ulf Leonhardt, Stefan Rotter
arxiv-2112-01420.description: Abstract Coordinate transformations are a versatile tool to mould the flow of light, enabling a host of astonishing phenomena such as optical cloaking with metamaterials. Moving away from the usual restriction that links isotropic materials with conformal transformations, we show how non-conformal distortions of optical space are intimately connected to the complex refractive index distribution of an isotropic non-Hermitian medium.

arxiv-2210-01836.title: Disentangling Growth and Decay of Domains During Phase Ordering
arxiv-2210-01836.creator: Suman Majumder
arxiv-2210-01836.description: Abstract Using Monte Carlo simulations we study the phase ordering dynamics of a multi -species system modeled via the prototype q q -state Potts model. In such a multi -species system, we identify a spin states or species as the winner if it has survived as the majority in the final state, otherwise we mark them as loser .

arxiv-2210-13310.title: Clustering Plasma Concentration-Time Curves: Applications of Unsupervised Learning in Pharmacogenomics
arxiv-2210-13310.creator: Jackson P. Lautier, Stella Grosser, Jessica Kim, Hyewon Kim, Junghi Kim
arxiv-2210-13310.description: Abstract Pharmaceutical researchers are continually searching for techniques to improve both drug development processes and patient outcomes. An area of recent interest is the potential for machine learning (ML) applications within pharmacology. One such application not yet given close study is the unsupervised clustering of plasma concentration-time curves, hereafter, pharmacokinetic (PK) curves.

arxiv-2301-07433.title: DDPEN: Trajectory Optimisation With Sub Goal Generation Model
arxiv-2301-07433.creator: Aleksander Gamayunov, Aleksey Postnikov, Gonzalo Ferrer
arxiv-2301-07433.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aleksander Gamayunov, Aleksey Postnikov, Gonzalo Ferrer. Differential dynamic programming (DDP) is a widely used and powerful trajectory optimization technique, however, due to its internal structure, it is not exempt from local minima. In this paper, we present Differential Dynamic Programming with Escape Network (DDPEN) - a novel approach to avoid DDP local minima by utilising an additional term used in the optimization criteria pointing towards the direction where robot should move in order to escape local minima.

arxiv-2309-00797.title: Numerical variational simulations of quantum phase transitions in the sub-Ohmic spin-boson model with multiple polaron ansatz
arxiv-2309-00797.creator: Yulong Shen and Nengji Zhou
arxiv-2309-00797.description: Abstract With extensive variational simulations, dissipative quantum phase transitions in the sub-Ohmic spin-boson model are numerically studied in a dense limit of environmental modes. By employing a generalized trial wave function composed of coherent-state expansions, transition points and critical exponents are accurately determined for various spectral exponents, demonstrating excellent agreement with those obtained by other sophisticated numerical techniques.

arxiv-2401-02082.title: Spectroscopic study of D − D- meson in Regge phenomenology
arxiv-2401-02082.creator: Juhi Oudichhya, Ajay Kumar Rai
arxiv-2401-02082.description: Abstract In last few years the experimental evidence of charmed mesons is increasing remarkably. In the present work we systematically studied the D D meson by employing Regge phenomenology. By assuming the existence of the quasilinear Regge trajectories, several relations between Regge slope, intercept, and meson masses have been extracted.

arxiv-2406-16620.title: OmAgent: A Multi-modal Agent Framework for Complex Video Understanding with Task Divide-and-Conquer
arxiv-2406-16620.creator: Lu Zhang, Tiancheng Zhao, Heting Ying, Yibo Ma, Kyusong Lee
arxiv-2406-16620.description: Abstract Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have expanded their capabilities to multimodal contexts, including comprehensive video understanding. However, processing extensive videos such as 24-hour CCTV footage or full-length films presents significant challenges due to the vast data and processing demands. Traditional methods, like extracting key frames or converting frames to text, often result in substantial information loss.

arxiv-2507-15108.title: Noise Quantification and Control in Circuits via Strong Data-Processing Inequalities
arxiv-2507-15108.creator: Chenyang Sun
arxiv-2507-15108.description: Abstract . This essay explores strong data-processing inequalities (SPDI’s) as they appear in the work of Evans and Schulman [ 1 ] and von Neumann [ 2 ] on computing with noisy circuits. We first develop the framework in [ 1 ] , which leads to lower bounds on depth and upper bounds on noise that permit reliable computation.

pmc-13589767.title: 脊髓Lamb1参与ACC-SDH通路调控负性情绪易化神经病理性疼痛的机制
pmc-13589767.creator: 健 王, 卓峰 丁, 伟 徐, 望远 邹, 曲练 郭, 宗斌 宋
pmc-13589767.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的神经病理性疼痛常伴焦虑、抑郁情绪，形成疼痛-负性情绪共病状态，其具体机制目前仍未阐明。本研究旨在探讨前扣带回皮质(anterior cingulate cortex，ACC)-脊髓背角(spinal dorsal horn，SDH)下行通路在负性情绪易化神经病理性疼痛中的调控机制，筛选并验证其在脊髓水平发挥作用的关键分子。方法采用雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠构建慢性不可预见性轻度应激(chronic unpredictable mild stress，CUMS)联合慢性缩窄性损伤(chronic constriction injury，CCI)模型，用以模拟负性情绪易化神经病理性疼痛状态。其中，CUMS持续21 d，每日随机给予2种不同应激刺激；CCI模型通过结扎左侧坐骨神经建立。采用糖水偏好实验(sucrose preference test，SPT)和强迫游泳实验评估抑郁样行为，采用von-Frey法检测机械痛阈值。通过向SDH注射逆行腺相关病毒(adeno-associated virus，AAV)-环化重组酶(cyclization recombination enzyme，Cre)、向ACC区注射CRE依赖型hM4Di病毒，结合氯氮平N-氧化物(clozapine-N-oxide，CNO)连续14 d腹腔注射给药，特异性抑制ACC-SDH投射神经元活性，并进行行为学观察。在CCI术后第7天，取腰膨大脊髓组织进行转录组测序，筛选差异表达基因，结合基因本体论(gene ontology，GO)及通路富集分析明确候选分子的功能特征，并采用蛋白质印迹法(Western blotting，WB)和免疫荧光验证候选分子层粘连蛋白β1亚基(laminin subunit beta-1，Lamb1)的表达变化、分布特征及细胞定位。进一步向SDH注射AAV敲减Lamb1的表达，观察其对ACC-SDH通路抑制后镇痛效应及情绪相关行为的影响。结果CUMS处理可诱导大鼠出现明显抑郁样行为，并进一步加重CCI所致机械痛敏。抑制ACC-SDH通路后，自CCI术后第3天至第10天，大鼠的机械痛阈值明显升高，并且在CCI术后第7天最为显著(均P<0.05)。RNA测序结果显示，抑制ACC-SDH神经元活性后脊髓中共有126个差异表达基因，其中94个上调、32个下调，主要涉及细胞外基质、突触功能、神经元结构及疼痛相关过程。Lamb1为上调最显著的候选分子。WB结果证实，特异性抑制ACC-SDH投射神经元活性后，脊髓中Lamb1蛋白的表达水平升高，而CUMS+CCI组脊髓Lamb1表达低于CCI+control组(均P<0.05)。免疫荧光染色结果显示，Lamb1在脊髓中广泛分布，主要富集于SDH浅层，并与神经元、小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞呈现空间邻近分布。敲减脊髓Lamb1后，可以下调AAV-hM4Di组大鼠的机械痛阈值，并加重CCI大鼠的痛觉过敏。结论Lamb1在脊髓水平参与ACC-SDH通路调控负性情绪易化神经病理性疼痛的过程。本研究从脑-脊髓下行调控角度揭示了疼痛-负性情绪共病的脊髓分子基础，为干预负性情绪相关神经病理性疼痛提供了新策略。 神经病理性疼痛是常见的慢性疼痛，其发病率可达5%~10%[1]。神经病理性疼痛常伴发焦虑、抑郁等负性情绪；而长期存在的负性情绪又可进一步加重患者的疼痛感知，随着病程进展逐渐形成疼痛-负性情绪共病状态，导致神经病理性疼痛迁延难愈，并带来一系列心理、行为及社会问题[2-3]。因此，探究负性情绪与疼痛感知之间的调控机制，对于完善对神经病理性疼痛发病机制的认识及寻找潜在治疗靶点具有重要意义。 前扣带回皮质(anterior cingulate cortex，ACC)是中枢神经系统疼痛相关皮质网络的重要组成部分，不仅参与疼痛情感成分的形成和痛觉调控，也与焦虑、抑郁等负性情绪的发生、发展密切相关[4]。近年来研究[5]发现，脑下行调控系统可通过改变脊髓神经元兴奋性和局部敏化水平参与疼痛的发生、发展。ACC可直接发出投射纤维至脊髓背角(spinal dorsal horn，SDH)，形成ACC-SDH通路，并在疼痛易化中发挥作用[6]。本课题组前期研究[7]发现，在抑郁合并神经病理性疼痛的模型大鼠中，ACC-SDH投射神经元活性增强；抑制ACC-SDH通路活性可缓解负性情绪对神经病理性疼痛的易化作用。然而，该通路在脊髓水平通过何种关键分子介导上述效应，目前尚不清楚。 层粘连蛋白(laminin)是细胞外基质(extracellular matrix，ECM)的重要组成成分，属于由α、β和γ链组成的异源三聚体糖蛋白家族。Laminin β1亚基(laminin subunit beta-1，Lamb1)在皮层中高表达，并参与精神障碍及疼痛-抑郁共病的发生[8-9]。然而，Lamb1在负性情绪易化神经病理性疼痛中的作用，尤其是其是否参与ACC-SDH通路介导的脊髓调控机制，仍缺乏直接证据。 本研究采用慢性不可预见性轻度应激(chronic unpredictable mild stress，CUMS)联合慢性缩窄性损伤(chronic constriction injury，CCI)建立负性情绪易化神经病理性疼痛大鼠模型，并结合化学遗传学、转录组测序、蛋白质印迹法(Western blotting，WB)及免疫荧光等方法，筛选并验证ACC-SDH通路在负性情绪易化神经病理性疼痛过程中所涉及的脊髓关键分子，重点探讨Lamb1在其中的作用，以期为疼痛-负性情绪共病机制研究及潜在干预靶点的筛选提供理论依据。 材料与方法 伦理声明 本研究已通过中南大学湘雅医院医学伦理委员会批准(审批号：2023111570)，所有实验设计与操作均遵循国际疼痛学会的动物实验伦理准则。 实验动物及分组 体重160~180 g的雄性Sprague-Dawley大鼠购自湖南斯莱克景达实验动物有限公司，以4~5只/笼饲养，处于12 h光/暗交替周期，自由摄食、饮水。动物饲养与使用遵循美国国立卫生研究院《实验动物护理和使用指南》。所有动物行为学实验均在双盲条件下进行。CUMS实验中，假手术(Sham)+对照(control)组、Sham+CUMS组、CCI+control组、CCI+CUMS组各6只大鼠。腺相关病毒(adeno-associated virus，AAV)注射实验中，AAV-control组、AAV-化学遗传学抑制(记为hM4Di)组各13只大鼠，其中6只用于行为学检测和c-Fos表达水平验证，3只用于RNA测序、4只用于Lamb1的WB分析；AAV-hM4Di+乱序对照序列(记为scramble)组、AAV-hM4Di+敲减Lamb1(记为siLamb1)组各10只大鼠，其中6只用于行为学检测，4只用于Lamb1的WB分析；CUMS+CCI+scramble组、CUMS+CCI+siLamb1组、CCI+scramble组、CCI+siLamb1组各6只大鼠。 方法 CUMS模型建立 按既往研究[10]中的方法建立CUMS模型，包括食物或饮水剥夺、潮湿或干燥垫料、拥挤或单笼饲养、昼夜节律颠倒、冷水或热水强迫游泳、尾夹、笼具震荡、束缚、噪音及气味刺激等多种应激源。于21 d内每日随机给予2种不同刺激，以保证刺激的不可预见性。 CCI模型建立 采用异氟烷对大鼠进行全身麻醉后，建立神经病理性疼痛CCI模型[11]。钝性分离股二头肌后暴露左侧坐骨神经，采用4-0丝线于坐骨神经周围打4个松结，结间距1 mm。假手术组仅暴露坐骨神经，不进行结扎。对于CUMS+CCI组，大鼠自手术前21 d(记为第-21 d)开始接受CUMS刺激，于手术当天(记为第0天)进行CCI手术。 机械痛阈值测定 大鼠机械痛阈值的测定方法参考既往文献[12]，将大鼠置于测试笼内适应30 min后，使用von-Frey针垂直刺激其左侧足底中部，针丝弯曲并保持2~3 s后，若出现抬足或舔足反应，则记为阳性。每次测量间隔5 min，记录出现阳性反应时的最小刺激强度作为机械痛阈值。 糖水偏好实验 糖水偏好实验(sucrose preference test，SPT)参照既往研究[13]进行。大鼠先适应性饮用1%蔗糖溶液48 h。正式实验前禁水14 h，测试时单笼饲养，每笼放置1瓶1%蔗糖溶液和1瓶纯净水，自由饮用4 h，每2 h交换2个溶液瓶的位置。记录2种液体的摄入量，按蔗糖溶液摄入量除以总液体摄入量计算蔗糖偏好率。 强迫游泳实验 在强迫游泳实验中，将大鼠置于装有水的透明玻璃圆柱体中(直径20 cm，水深30 cm，室温)，方法参照既往研究[14]。前2 min为训练阶段，随后4 min为测试阶段。根据录像，当大鼠停止挣扎、呈漂浮状态时，视为不动，并记录不动时间。计算4 min测试阶段内的总不动时间。 转录组测序 转录组测序由数谱(上海)生物科技有限公司完成。具体实验流程：提取的总RNA样品经琼脂糖电泳和Nanodrop质检和定量后，用寡聚(dT)磁珠富集信使RNA(messenger pmc-13617596.title: Relationships between basement membrane zone thickness and airway physiology, epithelial gene expression and innate immune cell infiltration in asthma
pmc-13617596.creator: Matthew Liu, Ryan C. Murphy, Ashley Mazzotta, Ying Lai, Jonathan Lee, Stephen R. Reeves, Teal S. Hallstrand
pmc-13617596.description: RationaleThickening of the basement membrane zone (BMZ) has often been identified in airway biopsies of individuals with asthma, but the relationship of BMZ thickness to airway dysfunction and inflammation is incompletely understood. The objectives of the present study were to characterise the relationship between BMZ thickness and airway physiology, immune cell infiltration and airway gene expression.

pmc-13688813.title: Effectiveness of Gross’s emotion regulation training on death anxiety in leukemia patients undergoing chemotherapy: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13688813.creator: Rafat Rezapour-Nasrabad, Amir Musarezaie, Zakiye Ghelbash, Tahere Momeni-Ghaleghasemi, Mahtab Naraghirad
pmc-13688813.description: BackgroundDeath anxiety is common among leukemia patients undergoing chemotherapy and can adversely affect quality of life. This randomized controlled trial evaluated the short-term effect of Gross’s emotion regulation training on death anxiety in this population.MethodsThis single-blind (data analyst-blinded), parallel-group randomized controlled trial was conducted at Omid Hospital, Isfahan, Iran, in 2024.

pmc-13694481.title: Early- versus late-onset mortality trends in breast and female genital cancers in Spain, 1999–2024
pmc-13694481.creator: Lucía Cayuela, Antoni Llueca, Julián Librero, Victoria Achaval, Francisco Herrero Machancoses, Aurelio Cayuela
pmc-13694481.description: BackgroundBreast and gynaecological cancers represent the leading oncological burden among women worldwide. We aimed to describe long-term mortality trends for these malignancies in Spain over a 26 year period, focusing on differences between early-onset (< 50 years) and late-onset (≥ 50 years) disease.MethodsMortality data (1999–2024) were obtained from the Spanish National Institute of Statistics.
